bpmn:process.name: Ingredient Stock Restocking
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md (all subprocess scopes and reuse rules); Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md SRS 4.12 FR-INV-01-02,13-14,17-18 and inventory interface requirements; index.html and linked app/inventory-state.js I.change/I.move, app/owner-inventory.js openStock, app/staff-ui.js stockForm and app/staff-state.js. Existing docs BPMNs reviewed for conventions, including inventory-control.bpmn.xml, a broader predecessor whose invocation would duplicate restocking and adjustments. No existing BPMN is modified. SRS takes precedence. Vertical internal responsibility lanes in one pool; sequence flows cross lanes, so no message flows are required. BPMN-30 authentication is a precondition; authorization is rechecked here. A post-commit signal references separately triggered BPMN-27 without waiting; BPMN-15 owns separate subscription reservation retry. Those two bounded diagrams are catalog entries without XML yet, so no unresolved calledElement or placeholder process is introduced. No monitoring, notifications, reservations or price-approval detail is duplicated. BPMN-25 owns physical/system discrepancies and required adjustment reasons, not restocking. This descriptive non-executable process records received stock, not purchasing, automatic supplier ordering or preparation.

bpmn:startEvent.name: Received ingredients ready to record
bpmn:startEvent.bpmn:documentation: Physical receipt precedes recording. Supplier purchasing is outside scope.

bpmn:userTask.name: Select ingredient; review current stock and unit
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-01-02. Use an existing ingredient record. Authentication is a precondition: Refer to BPMN-30.

bpmn:userTask.name: Enter quantity, unit, Total Cost and optional Notes
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-13. Require positive received quantity, compatible unit and nonnegative Total Cost in PHP with at most two decimal places; allow optional Notes. Prevent repeated submissions while saving. Closing before submission leaves stock unchanged.

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Validate access, ingredient, quantity, unit and Total Cost
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-13-14,18. Recheck Admin/Owner or authorized Staff access; validate ingredient, finite positive quantity and compatible unit. Normalize supported units; the prototype allows three quantity decimals and whole pieces. Require nonnegative PHP Total Cost to at most two decimal places under FR-INV-13. Validate operation identity: identical saved requests return their recorded result without another increase; conflicting reused identifiers are rejected.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Valid restock?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Invalid or unauthorized entries cause no stock or movement changes.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Show rejection; retain input for correction
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Explain invalid input or denied access. Corrections may be submitted as another attempt; BPMN-30 owns authentication recovery.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save stock, weighted-average unit cost and restock movement
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-14,17-18. Normalize received quantity to the ingredient base unit. Updated unit cost = ((physical stock before restocking * previous unit cost) + restock Total Cost) / (physical stock before restocking + received quantity). Use physical stock including reserved stock, not available stock. With zero prior stock, unit cost = Total Cost / received quantity. Add received quantity to latest physical stock; record ingredient, positive movement, Total Cost, timestamp, responsible account, before/after stock and optional Notes. Save unit cost, stock and movement together. Preserve reserved quantities. Commit consistently without partial stock/ledger changes. Identical previously saved requests return their saved result without duplicate effects. Updated ingredient cost feeds subsequent costing under FR-PRICE-02,14; price approval belongs to BPMN-40 and is not invoked here.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Save successful?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Confirmed existing results take Yes. On unsuccessful save preserve prior stock and movement history.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Show save failure; retain input for safe retry
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Retry using the same operation identity to avoid a duplicate increase after an uncertain response.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Not recorded; retry available
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: No partial stock or movement update.

bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent.name: Stock changed: Refer to BPMN-27
bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent.bpmn:documentation: Signal Low-Stock Monitoring and Product Availability Control independently after a new commit. BPMN-27 owns thresholds, alerts and product availability; do not duplicate those rules or wait for notification delivery. Already recorded requests do not emit duplicate business effects.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Display updated stock and recorded movement
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-02,17-18. Show saved restock result and current recorded stock.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Restock recorded and traceable
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Stock is replenished, not reserved or consumed. Refer to BPMN-15 for separate failed subscription reservation retry after replenishment; restocking does not itself retry or confirm reservations.

bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: Separate catalog processes: BPMN-30: authentication precondition. BPMN-25: discrepancies / corrections. BPMN-27: monitoring after stock change. BPMN-15: failed subscription reservation retry after replenishment. Restocking does not reserve stock or start production.
